name: Haboob
desc: A wall of dust bearing down on a desert plain — parallax curtains of ochre stack far to near with real aerial perspective, Kelvin-Helmholtz rolls boil along the leading edge, torn streamers race across the foreground and the sun slowly drowns behind it as the wall closes, engulfs and passes over minutes.

energy.doc: wind strength — leading-edge lobe amplitude, roll vigour, streamer speed

scale.doc: wall height and lobe size against the frame

density.doc: number of parallax dust curtains, edge rolls and streamers

grain.doc: dust texture inside the curtains (halftone dots in duotone)

hue.doc: dust hue (30 = ochre); sky and shadow derive from it
